name: 555 Timer
rules: Across the channel, notch left: pin 1 bottom-left, pin 8 straight above it.
Pins 2 and 6 watch a capacitor. Above ⅔ VCC: output LOW, pin 7 drains it. Below ⅓ VCC: output HIGH again.
Pin 4 (RESET) must be tied high to run.
flavor: Designed by Hans Camenzind in 1971; still one of the most-made chips ever.
